name: store-open-tabs
title: Store Open Tabs
description:
State Saver lets you capture and restore browser tabs with a single command. Save snapshots of your open tabs across Chrome, Arc, Safari, and Brave, and restore them instantly whenever you need.

Whether you're switching between projects, resuming after a break, or managing multiple workflows, State Saver keeps your browser context intact so you can focus on what matters: doing your work, not setting it up.
author: ben_aguirre

commands.title: Save Browser Tabs
commands.subtitle: Save snapshots of your browser tabs
commands.description: Captures all open tabs from Chrome, Arc, Safari, and Brave browsers and saves them as a snapshot

commands.name: open-snapshot
commands.title: Restore Browser Tabs
commands.subtitle: Restore browser tabs from a saved snapshot
commands.description: Select and restore browser tabs from a saved snapshot

commands.name: view-snapshots
commands.title: View Snapshots
commands.subtitle: View all saved state snapshots
commands.description: Display and manage all saved state snapshots with their details

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.

" && exit 1
